Avoid concept raised snail-like relief if present: central body must lie below bedding plane, not domed living shell. Use narrow longitudinal side zones and short marginal transverse ruffles, not Dickinsonia full-width repeated modules or Spriggina median segmentation. P49391 observed central elongated smooth area, uneven frill-border grooves, rounded lower end and disturbed narrow upper end. Simplify preservation damage without inventing eyes/proboscis.
